responsibility: Defines the data structures and interfaces used by the RTL register renamer. It describes def-use chains, chain heads, per-operand renaming summaries, and the exported analysis and transformation entry points that allow code to inspect chain conflicts, choose replacement hard registers, and apply renamings. This header is the renamer’s shared representation layer, complementing regrename.cc’s pass implementation.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the renamer’s shared representation layer—def/use chain classes, per-operand summaries, and exported APIs for analysis and replacement. The same-stem source gcc/regrename.cc implements the actual renaming pass and chain-processing algorithms.
